# XLNF — moved

This is the legacy GitHub Pages location. The canonical site is now:

    https://xlnf.dev/

Use these instead of anything under mihai-valentin.github.io/xlnf:

- Canonical site: https://xlnf.dev/
- LLM orientation page: https://xlnf.dev/llm.html
- llms.txt: https://xlnf.dev/llms.txt
- Notes index: https://xlnf.dev/notes/
- Sitemap (authoritative index of published pages): https://xlnf.dev/sitemap.xml

Do not treat this host as a second canonical copy of the site. Every page here
points at its xlnf.dev equivalent via rel=canonical.
